• Creative testing: Develop concepts, hooks, ad copy and briefs. Coordinate creators/designers/editors, review their work and keep fresh creative variations moving.



• Specialist coordination: Identify when additional help is needed for advanced development, tracking,
 flows or creative production. Prepare clear briefs and manage delivery within approved budgets.



• Reporting: Provide a short daily progress/blocker update and a weekly summary of ad spend, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, average order value and recommended next actions.



You will work with our existing VA, who supports product sourcing and operational coordination. Approved specialist freelancer fees, software and advertising spend are funded separately from your compensation.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• Proven experience managing Meta purchase campaigns for Shopify ecommerce brands.

• Hands-on experience building or improving Shopify landing pages—not simply sending traffic to them.

• Strong understanding of margins, customer acquisition costs, creative testing and conversion tracking.

• Ability to prioritize, meet deadlines and communicate proactively.

• Supplement or wellness brand experience is strongly preferred.



BRAND REQUIREMENTS



Our marketing must be honest and use substantiated product claims. Our creative guidelines require male talent only and no women appearing in advertising images or videos. You must be comfortable following these guidelines and briefing creators accordingly.



INITIAL PRIORITIES



Review our launch plan, identify missing pieces, propose a practical timeline and testing budget, prepare the Shopify funnel, verify tracking and coordinate initial creatives. Launch campaigns once product availability and the agreed readiness checks are complete.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



Two relevant ecommerce case studies showing the product category, campaign dates, ad spend, CPA/ROAS and your exact responsibilities. Redacted evidence is welcome.



Links or screenshots of Shopify landing pages you personally built or improved, with conversion results where available.



Details of any supplement or wellness brand experience.



Which responsibilities you can execute yourself and which would require specialist support.



A brief outline of your first 30 days for a new supplement launch.



Your availability and expected monthly compensation for 20 hours/week.



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to a small paid practical assessment before an ongoing engagement.

title: Customer Support Assistant (Remote) – Swedish E-Commerce Company
description:
We are a Swedish company looking for a reliable and dedicated Customer Support Assistant to help us manage customer emails for several different brands. You will respond to inquiries in multiple languages using the translation tool 
.



Most customer questions will be related to:



Order status (“Where is my delivery?”)



Orders not received



Products not as expected



Returns and exchanges



General questions about the brand



You will work closely with our agents in China who handle packaging and shipping, as well as directly with our payment providers to resolve customer issues without needing our constant assistance.



Important Work Method (Please Read Carefully)



Everything is fully documented in detail, including clear step-by-step instructions on how to respond to each type of customer inquiry.



Every response must be:



Custom-written for each individual customer



Written in the customer’s language (English, Swedish, Danish, Finnish, etc.)



Created using ChatGPT to generate a natural and personalized reply



No copy-paste templates allowed – each message must be unique and tailored



It is very important that the guidelines and instructions are followed perfectly every time.



If you are ever unsure what to do, it is always better to ask questions and double-check. Accuracy is extremely important, and mistakes must be avoided. When in doubt, ask before taking action.



We are looking for someone who is detail-oriented and can maintain high quality and consistency in every response.



We need someone who can start immediately.



Tools & Daily Workflow



We use Google Sheets to track and manage important cases



Examples of cases that may need to be logged include:



Returns



Refunds



Chargebacks



Failed deliveries



Address issues



Customer complaints or special situations



Not all cases need to be logged, but when logging is required, it must be accurate, organized, and consistent



You should be comfortable working with Google Sheets and maintaining clear structure and order



Daily communication and coordination will be done via WhatsApp



Use "I AM READY" when applying for the job or your application will not be read.



What We Expect From You



A fast learner who is driven, organized, and detail-oriented



Someone who is willing to work consistently every day



A patient and polite communicator, even with difficult customers



A problem solver who always tries to fix issues before asking for help



Someone who always finishes what they start



Someone who is technical, consistent, hardworking, and always looking to improve



Strong English speaking and writing skills



Experience with email customer support, Shopify, and Google Sheets is a plus



Work Schedule



7 days a week



Approximately 1–2 hours per day (between 10 AM – 5 PM Swedish time)



Opportunity for increased hours in the near future (5–8 hours/day)



Future Opportunities



You should be willing and excited to learn new skills. Soon, you may also take on tasks such as:



Finding viral products



Searching for ad videos



Editing ad creatives



Writing ad copy



Building simple websites



Creating product descriptions



Communicating with UGC creators and influencers



Experience in these areas is a plus, but not required—we will train you.



Salary



20 SEK per hour



How to Apply



Please share:



A brief introduction about yourself



What you are currently doing



Your ambitions



Your relevant experience



We look forward to hearing from you!

Job Description:

The SOC & Backup Team Leader is responsible for leading and overseeing the Security Operations Center (SOC) and Backup functions across all managed environments. This role provides technical leadership, escalation support, quality assurance, operational oversight, and continuous improvement for security monitoring, i
 response, security posture, backup protection, and related service delivery. The Team Leader ensures that technicians have the knowledge, tools, procedures, and direction required to investigate and resolve issues properly, while maintaining appropriate documentation, SLA performance, client protection, and operational standards.



Roles and Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Development: Lead and coordinate the SOC and Backup teams, assign responsibilities, monitor workload and completion, coach technicians, provide technical guidance and performance feedback, and enforce established processes and service expectations. Technical Escalation: Serve as a primary escalation point for complex SOC and Backup issues. Review escalated tickets and investigations, validate troubleshooting and findings, identify missing investigation steps, provide technical direction, determine appropriate remediation, and coordinate escalation to different departments, management, or vendors when required. SOC Operations Oversight: Maintain working knowledge of Datto EDR/AV, BullPhish ID, DarkWeb ID, INKY, SaaS Alerts, ConnectSecure, RocketCyber, DUO, VPenTest, and Datto RMM SOC Dashboard operations. Oversee alerts involving malware, phishing, compromised accounts, suspicious activity, vulnerabilities, exposed credentials, MFA/security issues, endpoint protection gaps, and other cybersecurity concerns. Alert Optimization: Review alert volumes, severity, false positives, duplicate or recurring alerts, thresholds, detection rules, exclusions, suppressions, integrations, and automated ticket creation. Tune alerting and workflows to reduce unnecessary noise and ticket volume without reducing visibility into legitimate security events. I
 Response & I
 Report Review: Review significant security i
 and i
 reports to validate investigation quality, evidence, findings, actions taken, containment, remediation, communication, and final outcome. Identify gaps, recurring attack patterns, and additional preventive actions required. Security Posture & Compliance Oversight: Review security posture and control gaps including EDR/AV coverage, third-party antivirus, MFA, risky sign-ins, vulnerabilities, exposed credentials,
 security, and other security requirements. Support cybersecurity insurance readiness by reviewing applicable security controls, documentation, and evidence requirements. Backup Operations Oversight: Oversee Uniview, Spanning, and Synology C2 operations, including backup coverage, failures, retention, storage/capacity concerns, restore requirements, recurring issues, and escalations. Ensure devices and services remain protected and recoverable. Quality Assurance & Documentation: Review tickets, i
 reports, investigations, backup records, and technician documentation for completeness, accuracy, appropriate troubleshooting, evidence, resolution, and adherence to SOPs. Provide corrective coaching when work does not meet established standards. Process & SOP Management: Develop, maintain, and enforce SOC and Backup SOPs, checklists, workflows, escalation procedures, ticketing standards, alert optimization processes, audit procedures, and remediation playbooks. Reporting & Operational Oversight: Review SLA performance, ticket queues, alert trends, backup status, security metrics, workload, recurring issues, and operational risks. Communicate significant trends and recommendations to management and coordinate corrective actions. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for automation, alert tuning, workflow improvements, reduction of repetitive work, improved documentation, stronger security controls, improved backup coverage, and more consistent service delivery.

3+ years of experience in IT operations, cybersecurity/SOC, managed services, or a related technical environment. , investigations, i
 reports, technical documentation, and remediation activities. title: VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — SHORT-TERM & MID-TERM RENTAL OPERATIONS
description:
The Link Housing LLC is a fast-growing housing company specializing in mid-term rentals for insurance placements, traveling professionals, and relocating families. We are expanding rapidly and building an operations department from the ground up.



We are hiring a high-level Virtual Assistant (VA) who is not only capable of daily operational tasks, but is also skilled in creating SOPs, building processes, and developing the operational backbone of an entire department.



This role is ideal for someone who thrives in:



An unstructured environment,



Loves building systems,



Is proactive and self-driven,



Can anticipate needs before they are stated,



And wants to grow into a leadership or Operations Manager role.



This position does not come with pre-built systems.

You will be helping BUILD this department.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. SOP Creation & Department Development



Create, write, and refine Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for every part of the business



Identify gaps in workflow and independently propose better systems



Document processes clearly and organize them into a scalable operations manual



Build repeatable workflows for:



Guest communication

Cleaning coordination

Maintenance ticketing

Onboarding new properties

Insurance communication

Work closely with leadership to shape the operational structure as the company scales

• Serve as the primary point of contact for guests: respond promptly to inquiries, manage check-ins and check-outs, and provide ongoing support

• Draft, review, and manage lease agreements for short-term and mid-term stays

• Coordinate cleaning, maintenance, and vendor services across multiple properties

• Ensure properties are consistently guest-ready through remote checklists or communication with on-the-ground teams

• Maintain and update internal records, calendars, and booking systems

• Troubleshoot and resolve guest or property-related issues professionally and efficiently

• Assist with onboarding new properties into our system and organizing operational documentation



2. Guest Communication & Hospitality



Handle guest inquiries on Airbnb and email with warmth, professionalism, and speed

Communicate with insurance adjusters and case managers

Send booking confirmations, pre-arrival documents, weekly check-ins, and check-out messages

Follow hospitality principles to support displaced families and traveling professionals

Manage extensions, special requests, and escalations



3. Property Operations



Maintain and update 
 project boards

Coordinate cleaners (contracted vendors) and verify all turnovers with photos

Track maintenance issues and communicate with vendors when needed

Manage property profiles, inventories, utilities information, and house manuals

Assist with creating and improving listing descriptions and accuracy on Airbnb



4. Administrative Tasks



Build internal documentation for new hires and future tea
mbers

Organize data, folders, templates, and workflows inside Google Drive

Assist with onboarding new properties into our portfolio

Prepare summaries and updates for leadership

Create Leases and Run Background Checks for rentals not going through Airbnb

Reconcile Refundable Security Deposits and Aircover claims



REQUIREMENTS

Must-Have Skills:

Strong experience creating SOPs and building processes from scratch

Ability to think logically, structure workflows, and write clearly

Excellent written English and hospitality-centered communication

Experience with Airbnb messaging, property management, or guest support

Proficiency with 
 and Google Workspace

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and reliable

Self-starter who can work independently without constant instruction

Ability to make decisions and problem-solve in real time

Prior experience building an operations department

Hospitality, STR/MTR operations, or insurance housing background

Experience coordinating cleaners or contractors



HOW TO APPLY



Submit the following:

Resume

A 1-minute audio or video introduction

A photograph of your home computer set up with Airbnb on the desktop screen



Thank you and we look forward to speaking with you!

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
Title: Supply Chain Manager – Home Decor E-commerce (Part-time, growing to Full-time)

About us By Meredith is a premium home decor brand selling online to customers in the UK, USA and Australia. We work with international fulfilment partners and are building our own backend team. You'll be one of our first two team members, so you'll help shape how we work.

The role You make sure every order is processed and shipped on time, with healthy margins, and that problems are solved before the customer notices. You start at 4 hours per day, with the clear intention to grow into a full-time role as volume increases.

What you'll do

• Check all new orders every day and enter purchase prices in our dashboard to monitor margins (minimum 60%).

• Monitor orders that aren't fulfilled after 48 hours or show no tracking movement for 7 days, and resolve them with our fulfilment agents.

• Communicate daily and directly with our fulfilment agents in China via Slack, in English.

• Find an alternative supplier quote when an item can't be delivered, check the margin, and draft unavailable products in Shopify.

• Handle lost, damaged and wrong-item claims with suppliers and couriers, and claim refunds for returned parcels.

• Flag products with high refund rates or price increases that hurt margins.

• Post a short daily update and report on your KPIs: processing time max 5 days, delivery time max 14 days, orders with an issue max 5%.

• Work closely with our Customer Service & Dispute Specialist.

Must-haves

• At least 3 years of experience in supply chain or order management for e-commerce / dropshipping.

• Proven experience in the home decor niche (furniture, decor, homeware).

• Experience working with Chinese suppliers or fulfilment agents.

• Hands-on experience with all the tools we use: Shopify, Slack, ParcelPanel (or similar tracking apps), Gorgias and Whop.

• Strong written English.

• Comfortable with numbers: margins, purchase prices, shipping costs.

• Structured and independent: you spot problems early and come with a solution, not just the problem.

• Reliable internet connection and your own computer.

Nice to have

• Experience with order and margin dashboards or spreadsheets.

• Experience with shipments to the UK, USA and Australia.

Schedule and pay

• 4 hours per day, Monday to Saturday (24 hours per week), in the morning UK time.

• Growth to full-time as volume increases.

• Pay: USD 2.75 per hour (around USD 285 per month), with a raise when moving to full-time.

How to apply To show you've read this post, start your application with the words "Home Decor Supply". Then tell us in a few sentences:

1. Your experience in the home decor niche, and with which stores or brands.

2. How you would handle an order that hasn't shipped after 5 days while the supplier doesn't reply.

3. Which of our tools you've worked with, and for how long.

Shortlisted candidates do a short paid test task and an interview. Applications without the opening words won't be considered.

title: Customer Service & Dispute Specialist
description:
Title: Customer Service & Dispute Specialist – Home Decor E-commerce (Part-time, growing to Full-time)

About us By Meredith is a premium home decor brand selling online to customers in the UK, USA and Australia. We are building our own backend team, and you'll be one of our first two team members, so you'll help shape how we work.

The role You are the voice of By Meredith. You make sure every customer gets a premium, helpful reply within 24 hours, and you protect the business by handling disputes quickly and thoroughly. You start at 4 hours per day, with the clear intention to grow into a full-time role as volume increases.

What you'll do – Customer service

• Answer all customer
s in Gorgias within 24 hours, including weekends, in a formal and premium tone (British English).

• Handle order status questions, delays, cancellations, address and size changes, damaged or wrong items, lost parcels and exchanges, following our SOPs.

• Solve problems before they turn into a bad review or dispute: store credit first, partial refunds where it fits, full returns as a last option.

• Process refunds in Whop and register returns in Gorgias.

• Make decisions on your own up to an agreed limit, and escalate anything above it with a clear proposal.

What you'll do – Disputes

• Build a complete evidence pack (order confirmation, tracking, terms acceptance, customer
s, product information) and submit it in Whop within 3 days.

• Help keep our chargeback ratio well below 1.5% and reach a 90% win rate.

Must-haves

• At least 3 years of experience in e-commerce customer service and handling disputes/chargebacks.

• Hands-on experience with all the tools we use: Gorgias, Shopify, Whop, Klaviyo, ParcelPanel and Slack.

• Excellent written English with a formal, premium tone; comfortable with British English spelling.

title: Sales
description:
Sales Caller for US Company – $4/hr + Big Commissions – Excellent English Required



Remote | Philippines Preferred | Hourly + Commission | Long-Term Opportunity



Hello, and thanks for stopping by!



We're a small, friendly marketing company based in Boise, Idaho, USA. We run online ads that connect homeowners who need tree work with local tree companies. Each company gets calls exclusively in its own area, and they get to try us free for 14 days before d
 anything.



We're growing, and we're looking for a warm, confident caller to grow with us long-term.



The one thing we care about most is spoken English. You'll be chatting with American business owners, so we're looking for someone who speaks English fluently and naturally, and who's comfortable with a real conversation — questions, surprises, and all. If you've spoken with US customers before, that's a big plus.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



* Call US tree company owners from a list we provide — no hunting for your own leads.

* Introduce our free 14-day trial using a simple script we'll give you.

* Have friendly, natural conversations and answer basic questions.

* If an owner asks about price, it's $2,250 per month after the trial, and there's no obligation to continue.

* Help interested owners complete our short sign-up form.

* Follow up with owners who asked for a callback.

* Keep simple notes on your calls in HubSpot (we'll show you how).



We provide the calling list, the script, the CRM, and a US phone number for your calls.



WHAT YOU'LL EARN



$4 USD per hour (up to 20 hours per week), plus commissions — and the commissions are where it gets good:



* $50 when a company signs up and starts its free 14-day trial.

* $500 when the company makes its first monthly payment.

* $100 bonus when the company makes its third monthly payment.



That's $650 for every client who signs up and stays with us. There's no cap on commissions.



We pay every Friday through Wise. Each sign-up is verified before commissions are paid — it's just how we keep things fair for everyone.



HOURS & FLEXIBILITY



Work from home and plan your own schedule. There are no fixed daily hours and no call quotas — we just ask that calls happen during reasonable US business hours, and that follow-ups don't get forgotten. We'd love to find someone who enjoys this kind of work and wants to be part of the team for the long haul.



YOU'D BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU...



* Speak English fluently, clearly, and naturally — this matters more to us than anything else.

* Enjoy talking with people and sound friendly and confident on the phone.

* Have called US businesses or customers before (preferred, but not required).

* Are honest and dependable, and would never promise a business owner results we can't guarantee.

* Have reliable internet, a quiet place to call from, and a good headset.



HOW TO APPLY



Applying takes about two minutes — just two steps:



1. Start your application with the words TREE CALLS (this just tells us you read the post).



2. Tell us a little about your experience and availability — any experience calling US businesses, when you're available during US business hours, and why this sounds like a good fit for you.



That's all for now. If we like your application, we'll message you and ask for a short video introducing yourself (30 to 60 seconds — just your name and a bit about your experience, nice and relaxed). You can share it as an unlisted YouTube link or a Google Drive link set to "Anyone with the link." Since spoken English is the heart of this job, the video is how we get to hear it before a quick interview.



Thanks so much for your time — we look forward to meeting you!

title: AI Video Creator & Editor — Higgsfield AI
description:
# AI Video Creator & Editor — Higgsfield AI



**Company:** VanishedOC  

**Position:** Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term  

**Starting Pay:** $2/hour (40 hours/week)  

**BONUSES + PERMANENT PAY RAISES FOR VIRAL VIDEOS!**



### About Us



VanishedOC is an automotive brand looking for a highly creative and experienced AI video creator/editor to produce viral-style content for TikTok and Instagram.



We're looking for someone who can independently come up with great video ideas, generate realistic footage using Higgsfield, and turn those ideas into fully edited, engaging videos.



**We're NOT looking for someone who just knows how to generate AI videos. We want someone who understands what makes videos go viral and has the creativity to consistently come up with great concepts.**



### 💰 PAY & VIRAL VIDEO BONUSES — IMPORTANT!



We want to reward people who produce results, not just people who complete tasks.



Your starting pay is **$2/hour for 40 hours per week**, but that's only the beginning.



Here's how you can earn more:



- **30,000+ Views:** Earn a performance bonus when your video reaches 30K authentic, organic views from our target audience.

- **100,000+ Views:** Earn an additional bonus AND receive a **permanent $0.25/hour raise**.

- **Every Additional Viral Video:** Each new qualifying video that reaches 100K+ views earns another bonus and another permanent $0.25/hour raise.

- **No fixed cap on performance-based raises:** The more qualifying viral videos you create, the higher your hourly rate can grow.



For example, if you consistently create videos that reach 100K+ views:



| Qualifying viral videos | New hourly rate |

|---|---|

| Starting rate | $2.00/hr |

| 4 videos | $3.00/hr |

| 8 videos | $4.00/hr |

| 12 videos | $5.00/hr |

| 20 videos | $7.00/hr |



**These raises are permanent, not one-time bonuses!**



If you're genuinely good at creating engaging content and consistently produce viral videos, you have the opportunity to earn significantly more than the starting rate.



All qualifying views must come from legitimate viewers within our target audience. Artificial or botted engagement does not qualify. Bonus amounts and verification terms will be confirmed before hiring.



**We're looking for someone who sees this as an opportunity to grow, not just another hourly job.**



### Responsibilities



- Produce **5 GOOD, fully finished videos per week**.

- Independently brainstorm original, engaging video concepts.

- Generate realistic, high-quality AI footage using Higgsfield.

- Create accurate starting frames to reduce wasted AI credits.

- Edit videos with music, sound effects, transitions, and strong pacing.

- Research trends, hooks, and successful viral content.

- Use our existing B-roll, AI footage, and product references when appropriate.

- Continuously experiment with new concepts and improve video performance.



### Requirements



- Previous experience with Higgsfield or similar AI video generation tools.

- Strong editing skills (CapCut, Premiere Pro, etc.).

- Excellent creativity and understanding of viral short-form content.

- Ability to independently develop attention-grabbing video concepts.

- Experience generating realistic AI footage with consistent product details.

- Ability to optimize starting frames and use AI credits efficiently.

- Strong attention to detail, reliability, and willingness to improve.



**CREATIVITY IS OUR #1 PRIORITY.** We want someone who thinks outside the box, brings their own ideas, and genuinely puts effort into making great videos.



### What We Provide



- **9,000 Higgsfield credits per month**, fully covered by us.

- Existing AI footage, automotive B-roll, and product reference images.

- Training on our workflow, content style, and creative expectations.

- Ongoing feedback and guidance.

- Long-term opportunity with performance-based bonuses and permanent pay increases.



### 🎬 IMPORTANT — SAMPLE VIDEO REQUIRED TO APPLY



We receive a lot of applications, so instead of long cover letters, we want to see what you can actually create.



**Before applying, search VanishedOC on TikTok and Instagram** to understand our product and content style.



Then create **ONE original video** that you believe would perform well for our brand.



Your video must:

- Be 10–20 seconds long, vertical 9:16.

- Include realistic AI-generated footage.

- Be fully edited with music, sound effects, and engaging pacing.

title: Outreach & Admin VA (NDIS, Sales/BD)
description:
Wellness Experts is a growing Sydney allied health provider (psychology, OT, speech and behaviour support) working with NDIS participants. We're looking for a sharp, confident VA who wants a long-term role with us.



This role is heavily focused on OUTREACH. Building relationships with Support Coordinators and referrers is what keeps our clinicians' diaries full. It's also a dynamic role: between outreach calls you'll be processing referrals, setting up new clients in Splose, organising with our clinicians and keeping admin moving. If you enjoy picking up the phone, following up, and turning a cold contact into a referral partner, and you're happy switching between that and admin, you'll do well here. Every referral you bring in earns you a bonus, paid weekly.



SET UP TO SUCCEED

You won't be figuring things out on your own. We've built a proper outreach system: SOPs, call scripts,
 templates, gatekeeper playbooks and a Notion database tracking every contact. You'll be trained by our current VA, who built many of our referral relationships herself. If you've done sales or BD before, you'll hit the ground running and can put your energy into building relationships instead of working out the process.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Outreach to Support Coordinators, plan managers and other referrers by phone and
, using our scripts, templates and Notion system

- Following up leads and keeping our outreach data accurate and up to date

- Being the first point of contact for new referrals and warm lead calls

- Processing new referrals and setting up clients in Splose, our practice management system, accurately and promptly

- Coordinating with our clinicians on bookings, availability and new client allocations

- Responding to participants and families over
, SMS and phone, with warmth and professionalism

- General admin: chasing overdue invoices, inbox management, and whatever else comes up. There's no script for every scenario, so we need someone who uses their judgement.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Sales, business development or outreach experience is preferred

- NDIS experience is strongly preferred. Knowing how Support Coordinators and referrals work is a big advantage.

- Confident on the phone and not put off by gatekeepers or follow-ups

- Comfortable juggling outreach and admin across the day without dropping the ball

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently

- Notion experience is a bonus



PAY, HOURS AND GROWTH

- $8 to $11/hr (AUD) depending on experience and performance

-  Paid bonus for every referral you bring in that becomes a client, paid weekly

- 5 to 6 hours a day (around 25 to 30 hours a week) to start

- Growing to 7 to 8 hours a day as the business grows and you find your feet

- Paid two-week trial





We're growing quickly and want someone to grow with us.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Record a 2-minute voice message. Spend 30 seconds introducing yourself, then pitch Wellness Experts to an NDIS Support Coordinator as if you were calling them for the first time. Check out our website first. Use Vocaroo, Google Drive or Loom and paste the link in your application.

2. Start your application with the words "OUTREACH VA" so we know you've read the full post.

3. Tell us briefly about your sales or BD experience, and any NDIS experience you have.



Applications without a voice recording won't be considered.
salary: $8 to $11+ and BONUSES + Paid Sick leave

title: Remote Sales & Enrollment Rep — Dance Studio (Part Time to Full Time Opportunity).
description:
IF SALES CONVERSATIONS ENERGIZE YOU AND YOU HATE LETTING A LEAD GO COLD, THIS ROLE WAS BUILT FOR YOU.



We are a dance studio that has built something real in our community. What we do goes far beyond teaching dance. We build confidence, friendships, leadership, and skills that stay with people for life. Every family that reaches out to us is already looking for that. Your job is to make sure they find it, and to bring more people into what we are building.



We are hiring one person to own this role. Not manage it. Own it.





WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY IS



This is a part time, remote sales role. The heart of it is outbound and inbound outreach to warm leads, real people who have already expressed interest in the studio. Your job is to be the first voice they hear, build genuine connection quickly, and guide them toward enrollment through real conversations.



When lead flow is strong, you are following up. When there is downtime, you are prospecting, going out and finding new families through social media, community groups, and online platforms. You are not waiting for things to come to you. You are making them happen.



You will also support the studio with weekly
s to leads and occasionally contribute to social media content. These are a small part of the role, but they are consistent and they count.



This role has a real growth path. If you are consistently converting leads and bringing new families into the studio, the hours are there to grow with you. The right person will not stay part time for long.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Contact new leads immediately when they come in. Speed is a real advantage in enrollment. First contact almost always wins.



- Follow up with prospective families and adult students through calls, texts, and
s using a structured cadence.



- Manage your pipeline and know where every lead stands at all times. Log your activity and report daily.



- Prospect for new leads during downtime through social media, community groups, and online platforms.



- Write weekly
s to leads and support social media content as needed.



- Show up as a true team player. The studio owner may occasionally bring you into tasks outside your core scope. If it supports the studio's growth, you are in. That flexibility and willingness to contribute is something we value deeply in whoever joins this team.





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



These are our priorities, in order:



- Phone presence above everything else. You need to sound calm, natural, and confident on every call. Not scripted. Not stiff. The kind of person who can hold a real conversation, earn trust quickly, and move it forward without forcing anything. If that description fits you, you are already ahead of most applicants.



- Fluent in spoken and written English at a C1 level or higher. This will be assessed.



- Experienced in sales, outreach, appointment setting, or enrollment based roles.



- Organized and reliable. You manage your leads, report your activity, and stay on top of follow ups without needing reminders.



- Self directed and comfortable working independently.



- Energized by conversations and motivated by real results.



- Familiar with CRM tools or lead tracking systems. Helpful but not required.



A background or interest in dance is a nice bonus. It is absolutely not required.





SCHEDULE



- 20 hours per week, spread across 7 days.



- The bulk of your hours fall on weekdays.



- Weekends are light, typically 1 to 3 hours, focused on inbound leads only. No outbound on weekends.



- Hours are scheduled within a window of 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM Pacific Time. Your actual schedule within that window is set with the studio owner and may shift by season. It will always be discussed and agreed on in advance.





TWO WEEK TRIAL PERIOD (Paid)



The role begins with a 2 week trial period to make sure there is a strong fit on both sides. During this time, we will be looking closely at reliability, communication, follow through, organization, quality of work, and how effectively you manage leads without needing constant direction.



At the end of the 2 weeks, we will review performance together and d
 whether to continue the role long term.





COMPENSATION



$250 per month, paid bi weekly via Wise.



This starts as a part time role. If you are consistently bringing new families into the studio, even a handful a month, there is a genuine path to full time. We want to give more hours to someone who is making the most of the ones they have. Results open doors here.





WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS



Every family that contacts this studio is already hoping for something meaningful. A place where their child grows. A community they can belong to. Your follow up, your voice, your consistency, that is what turns their interest into a yes. The right person in this role does not just fill a position. They change outcomes for real families.





TO APPLY



Send your resume and a short introduction. Tell us about a time you followed up with someone consistently and it made a real difference.



Include "Buzz Lightyear" in your subject line or message title. We read every application that includes it. Think of it as the first small sign that you are someone who reads carefully and follows through, two things that matter a lot in this role.

Carousels

Calls to action that generate leads and sales

 marketing and affiliate programs

title: Real Estate Lead Generation & Operations VA
description:
REAL ESTATE LEAD GENERATION & OPERATIONS VA

We are looking for a resourceful and experienced Virtual Assistant to join our growing real estate and short-term rental business.



This is NOT a basic data-entry VA role.



You should be comfortable researching properties, working with real estate leads, cold calling prospects, managing a CRM, and using AI tools to work efficiently.





MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE

Please apply ONLY if you have:

- PropStream — 3+ years experience

- GoHighLevel (GHL) — 3+ years experience

- Cold Calling / Outbound Prospecting — 3+ years experience

- ChatGPT — 1–2+ years experience

- Claude experience is a plus



We will train you on our processes, but we are not looking to train someone from scratch on these tools.





PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Experience with any of the following is a strong advantage:

- Airbnb / VRBO

- Zillow / Redfin / 

- Skip tracing

- Real estate lead generation

- Google Sheets

- Google Maps

- Google Reverse Image Search

- Public property records

- CRM management

- Short-term rentals

- Real estate investing or property management



WHAT YOU WILL DO

You may be responsible for:

- Researching properties and owners using PropStream

- Skip tracing and verifying contact information

- Managing leads and follow-ups in GoHighLevel

- Cold calling property owners and prospective clients

- Updating CRM notes, tasks, and pipeline stages

- Researching Airbnb and VRBO listings

- Using Zillow, Redfin, Google Maps, county records, and other sources

- Organizing research in Google Sheets

- Using ChatGPT or Claude for research, analysis, troubleshooting, and productivity

- Helping improve our lead-generation processes



THE TYPE OF PERSON WE WANT

1. Detective Work

Sometimes one website will not give you the answer.



You may need to search several sources, gather small pieces of information, and connect the dots to form the complete picture.



2. Organized

After doing all that research, we do not want the information to get lost.



Your work should be organized, documented, and easy to find later.



Do the work once and preserve it properly.



3. Ownership

Mistakes happen.



Own it. Fix it. Learn from it. Move on. Do not repeat it.



We value accountability, not excuses.



4. Independent & Resourceful

We will give you direction, but we do not want to explain every single step.



Try another search. Check another source. Use AI. Think through the problem.



Have the determination to finish the task at hand.



5. Sense of Urgency

If something can reasonably be finished today, there is no reason to push it to tomorrow.



Work efficiently, maintain accuracy, and keep things moving.



COLD CALLING

You must be comfortable speaking with property owners and prospects.



You should be able to:

- Speak clear English

- Have natural conversations

- Ask follow-up questions

- Handle basic objections

- Take accurate notes

- Update GHL correctly

- Follow up with leads when appropriate





++ IMPORTANT - READ BEFORE APPLYING ++

We want to learn about you, NOT how well AI can write your resume for you.



If you use AI to write or rewrite your resume, cover letter, or application response, you will NOT be considered.



Please apply using your own words.



Your English does not have to be perfect.



We would rather see your natural communication style and understand how you think.



This is NOT an anti-AI rule. We actively use ChatGPT and Claude in our business for automation.



We simply want to evaluate the real person behind the application first.





GROWTH OPPORTUNITY

This position can grow into more responsibility for the right person, including:

- Full time position

- Creating and improving SOPs

- Training other VAs

- Reviewing research

- Managing lead-generation workflows

- Managing team members

- Taking greater ownership of operations



Leadership ability is highly valued.



BEFORE YOU APPLY

Ask yourself:

Can I figure things out?

Am I organized?

Do I take ownership of mistakes?

Can I work independently?

Do I have a strong sense of urgency?



If yes — and you meet the experience requirements above — we would like to hear from you.

Dig until you find it.

Organize it so we do not lose it.

Own your work.

Figure things out.

Keep things moving.

title: General Admin & Dispatch Virtual Assistant (Electrical, ServiceM8)
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with hands-on ServiceM8 scheduling and dispatch experience, clear spoken English and strong listening comprehension will be prioritised for this role.



An Australian electrical services business needs a full-time General Admin and Dispatch VA to run the front end of a busy, reactive service operation: phones, inbox and the ServiceM8 schedule for 5 to 7 crews. The challenge is keeping control of a moving machine, with emergency jobs, calls and
s landing at once and the schedule changing through the day, while building real rapport with customers and technicians from outside an open-plan office where decisions are often made out loud.



The non-negotiables are hands-on ServiceM8 scheduling and dispatch experience, clear spoken English with strong listening comprehension, and a task creator rather than a task ticker. Success looks like a VA who is on the phones within the first week in a supported role, independently managing the schedule within 30 to 60 days, keeping records accurate with nothing left half-finished, and freeing the business owner from having to think about the phones, inbox or schedule.



What You'll Own



Scheduling & Dispatch (ServiceM8)



Independently manage daily schedules for 5 to 7 crews

Allocate jobs based on tech capability, job duration, location and travel time

Create new jobs in ServiceM8 with complete, accurate job details

Update existing jobs as details, timing or status change

Slot urgent and emergency bookings into the day and rework the schedule around them

Process cancellations, delays and reschedules as they happen

Keep job statuses current so the office and field team work from the same information

Learn each technician's strengths and which apprentices they're paired with

Over time, make day-to-day scheduling calls without waiting for sign-off, note the reasoning, and flag anything genuinely unusual



Phones (approx. 15-25 inbound calls per day)



Day 1/Week 1 starting task: listen to previous recorded calls to learn the business, common issues, and how the team handles customers

Answer inbound calls from customers and capture job details: name, address, contact number, access notes and fault description

Repeat back key details before ending every call

Identify emergency calls (e.g. no power, safety risk) and get a tech allocated immediately

Log every call outcome in ServiceM8



Inbox Management (approx. 20
s per day)



Day 1/Week 1 starting task: review the last 2-3 months of
 history across the admin inbox and the ServiceM8 inbox to learn how things are typically resolved

Clear the inbox first thing every morning

Manage all inbound channels: the general admin inbox, the ServiceM8 inbox, and system notifications

Action routine
s directly (booking requests, job updates, follow-ups)

Flag anything needing input with a short summary and a suggested next step

Get the inbox to zero, or as close as possible, by end of day



Customer & Technician Communication



Keep customers informed of bookings, arrival times, delays and changes

Keep technicians informed of schedule changes, new urgent jobs and job details

Follow through on every outstanding enquiry until it's closed



Team & Management Liaison



Work with the management team to keep day-to-day operations running smoothly

Raise scheduling conflicts, capacity issues and recurring problems early

Share what you're seeing in the schedule: bottlenecks, repeat callbacks, overloaded crews

When phones and inbox are under control, find the next useful task



Systems & Documentation



Record every training and handover session

Write an SOP for each task after training, then walk it through with the team to confirm it's the right process

Track ad hoc tasks: job-related ones tied to the job in ServiceM8, everything else in Google Tasks



Daily Communication



Morning message with the day's priorities

End-of-day
 report: tasks completed, work in progress, and items needing review, approval or attention



Out of Scope (Current)



Pricing

Invoicing, quoting, bookkeeping and payroll (handled by the business's accountant)



What We're Looking For



Experience



Hands-on ServiceM8 experience, particularly scheduling and dispatch (top priority)

Prior admin or dispatch experience in a service-based trades business, with electrical a strong bonus

Experience in a reactive environment with emergency or same-day work is a nice-to-have



Communication Skills



Clear, confident spoken English for daily calls with Australian customers (top priority)

Strong listening comprehension, including with customers who have strong accents or speak English as a second language

A warm, relaxed phone manner that builds rapport with clients and the field team

Habit of repeating back details and asking again rather than guessing

Comfortable saying "I'll find out and call you back" and following through



Technical Proficiency



ServiceM8: scheduling, dispatch, job creation, inbox, tasks, phone system

Gmail and Google Workspace (Gmail, Tasks, Meet, Chat)

WhatsApp

Willing to learn tools like Fathom quickly

Comfortable working across two screens with the full schedule displayed



Organisational Skills



Keeps control of a schedule that changes through the day

Prioritises well when urgent jobs, calls and
s land at once

Strong attention to detail on bookings, job notes and admin

Closes the loop: accurate records, nothing half-finished, nothing left sitting



Non-Negotiables



Task creator, not a task ticker — finds the next useful thing to do once urgent work is done

Flags when there isn't enough on and suggests work rather than waiting

Documents processes without being prompted

Comfortable making scheduling decisions and owning the outcome

Easygoing and approachable, with a personality fit that suits a relaxed, direct team culture — avoid overly formal, passive or deferential candidates

Access to dual monitors (a local purchase can be arranged if needed)



Working Arrangements



Full-time role, replacing an existing in-house position

Hands-on training sequence: an intro day, a "sit with me" day watching live operations, listening to recorded calls and reviewing inbox history, then a supported period answering calls

Likely joins an all-day virtual office (Google Meet) given the business's open-plan, d
-out-loud culture



Why This Role



Genuine ownership of the front end of a busy, reactive service business

Posh & Purpose Productions, a South Florida-based fashion and luxury event production company, is seeking a creative, reliable, and independent video editor to transform raw footage from fashion shows, runway events, photo shoots, and special events into compelling Instagram Reels and short-form social media videos.



IMPORTANT: We need someone who can independently review hours of raw, unorganized event footage, identify the most interesting and visually compelling moments, and creatively transform them into multiple polished videos without requiring detailed instructions or constant supervision.

Software Skills

Qualifications

• Ability to work independently with minimal creative direction.

title: Phone Sales Dialler
description:
🎯



**TL;DR:** We need experienced **outbound dialers** to make **200–400 calls a day** to warm leads and prospects already in our pipeline, and book them onto sales calls with our closers. Remote. **$500/month base + 5% commission on every deal you book that closes.** Must have outbound dialling experience, **perfect English**, and serious work ethic. **Read this page, apply at the link below, and submit an in-depth Loom video on why we should hire you: 
/hiring-setter**







# Why this role exists



We have more warm leads than we can call. Every day people opt in, apply, watch our VSL, come to our events and message us on Instagram. On top of that, there are hundreds of prospects already in our pipeline who spoke to us once and never got followed up properly.



Every one of those people put their hand up. When nobody calls them back fast, the money goes cold.



That is a **who** problem, not a **how** problem. You are the who.



Your job is simple: **pick up the phone, get the right people talking, and put qualified prospects on a call with our closers.** Do it 200–400 times a day, every day, and you will make yourself and this company a lot of money.



# Who we are



**7 Figure Scaling Systems (7FSS)**, founded by **Charlie Johnson**.



Charlie built one of the biggest online fitness coaching businesses in the UK. He has worked with **17,000+ clients**, generated **$20M+ online** across his companies, and won the **ClickFunnels Two Comma Club X award** (presented by Russell Brunson on stage in Las Vegas) for a single funnel that did over $10M.



Now we take everything that built that business and install it into other coaches' businesses: lead flow, sales, delivery, systems, team. We turn chaos into control and control into predictable income.



# Who you'll be calling



Our prospects are **online fitness coaches, personal trainers and fitness business owners**, mainly in the **US**, plus the UK, Ireland, Canada, Australia and the UAE. They are typically:



- **Starting out** (under $10K/month): good coach, no predictable lead flow, posting content and hoping

- **Stuck in the middle** ($10K–$50K/month): busy and burnt out, doing everything themselves, no systems and no sales team

- **Ready to scale** ($50K+/month): need the team, operating rhythm and infrastructure to reach $100K–$200K months



They are not cold. Every person on your list has **already shown interest**: they opted in, applied, watched our VSL, bought an event ticket, booked a call before, or spoke to a closer and didn't sign yet.



# What we sell



You don't sell on the phone. You **qualify and book**. But you need to know what's on the other side of the call so you book the right people:



- **7FSS (7 Figure Scaling Systems):** our flagship mentorship. Coaching, systems and support to scale a fitness coaching business: lead generation, sales, client delivery, team and operations. For coaches who are already making money and want to scale.

- **FPLS:** our programme for coaches at an earlier stage who need the foundations in place first (offer, niche, lead flow and sales).

- **Live events and masterminds:** e.g. the **Scaling Summit** in Dubai.



Programmes are **high-ticket, typically several thousand dollars**. That's why the person you book must have the **money, the motivation and the decision-making power**. Booking someone who can't afford it wastes a closer's time and earns you nothing.



# What you'll actually do



- **Dial 200–400 times a day** through our dialer and CRM

- Call **new warm leads within minutes** of them coming in. Speed to lead wins.

- Work through the **existing pipeline**: no-shows, people who didn't close, people who went quiet, old applicants

- Qualify every conversation: where their business is today, where they want it to be, what's stopping them, whether they can invest, and whether they make the decision

- **Book qualified prospects straight into our closers' calendars** and get them committed to showing up

- Follow up by call, SMS and voi
 until you get an answer. One attempt is not follow-up.

- Log **every** dial, outcome and note in the CRM the same day. If it's not in the CRM, it didn't happen.

- Post your numbers at end of day



# Our tools



- **Close CRM:** sales pipeline and dialer. Your call lists, notes and outcomes live here.

- **GoHighLevel (GHL):** lead capture, SMS follow-up and booking links

- **Slack:** team communication, booking notifications and EOD reports

- **Zoom:** where our closers run sales calls



Already used Close or GHL? Good, tell us. If you haven't, you'll need to learn them fast.



# The scorecard (how we measure you)



We don't measure hours. We measure output. This is your weekly scorecard:



| Metric | Target |

| --- | --- |

| Dials per day | 200 minimum, 400 is the standard |

| Speed to lead (new warm leads) | Called within 5 minutes during your shift |

| Qualified calls booked | Set in your first 2 weeks, based on your connect rate. Then it goes up. |

| Show rate on the calls you book | Above the team average |

| Booked calls that are qualified (money + decision maker) | 90%+ |

| CRM logging (every dial, outcome and note) | 100%, same day |

| EOD report posted | Every working day |



If your scorecard is green, nobody chases you about how you work. If it's red, we'll talk about it straight away. No surprises either way.



# Must-haves (non-negotiable)



- **Proven outbound dialling experience.** You've done high-volume outbound before (setting, SDR, appointment setting, call centre) and you can show us your numbers. No experience, no interview.

- **Perfect English.** Spoken and written. Our prospects are mainly American and British business owners. You have to sound confident, natural and easy to understand on the first "hello".

- **Huge work ethic and tenacity.** 200–400 dials a day means a lot of no's, voi
s and hang-ups. You keep going on call 300 the same way you did on call 1.

- **Thick skin.** Rejection doesn't slow you down. It's part of the job.

- **Organised.** Clean CRM, notes that a closer can read in 10 seconds, follow-ups never missed.

- **Reliable.** You show up for every shift, on time. If something's wrong, you say so before it becomes a problem.

- **Set-up:** quiet workspace, quality headset, stable internet, and availability during **US and UK calling hours**



# Nice-to-haves



- Experience with **Close** and/or **GoHighLevel**

- Experience setting for **high-ticket coaching, consulting or info offers**

- Understanding of the **fitness / online coaching** industry

- Experience with SMS and DM follow-up alongside calls



# Who this is NOT for



Be honest with yourself. You'll hate this role if:



- You think 200 dials is a lot. For us it's the minimum.

- You need someone to motivate you every morning

- You take "no" personally

- You want a guaranteed salary without having to perform. Most of the money in this role is commission.

- You're looking for a side gig to do around something else



# Who this IS for



- You love the phone and you're competitive about your numbers

- You want uncapped earnings tied directly to what you produce

- You want to work with a fast-growing team that gives more responsibility (and more money) to people who earn it

- You eventually want to move into closing. The best dialers learn the offer, the prospect and the objections better than anyone.



# How we work (our values)



- **Success loves speed.** Call fast, follow up fast.

- **Extreme ownership.** Your pipeline, your numbers, your result. No excuses, no blame.

- **Dependability.** Do what you said, when you said you'd do it.

- **Organised and prepared.** The CRM is always up to date.

- **Open and honest, even when it's painful.** Tell us what's working and what isn't. We'll do the same.



# Your first 30 days



- **Week 1:** Get set up in Close, GHL and Slack. Learn our offers, our prospects and the script. Listen to recorded sales calls. Start dialling.

- **Week 2:** Full volume: 200+ dials a day. Calls booked onto closers' calendars.

- **Weeks 3–4:** 300–400 dials a day, a consistent booking number, and a show rate above the team average

- **Day 30:** Hitting your scorecard every week



# Compensation



- **$500/month base**

- **5% commission on every deal you book that closes**

- Uncapped. The more qualified calls you book, the more you earn.

Remote, long-term role. Top performers get more leads, more responsibility, and a route into closing.

2. **Watch the full hiring video** at **
/hiring-setter**

3. **Click "Apply Now"** and complete the application

- **Why we should hire you** for this role, over everyone else applying

- **Your outbound experience:** where you've dialled, what you were selling, how long for

- **Your numbers:** dials per day, conversations, calls booked, show rate. Real numbers, not "a lot"

- **Why this role, and why now**



We want to hear how you speak, how you think and how hungry you are. Treat the Loom like your first call with us, because it is. Applications without numbers go to the bottom of the pile.

title: Social Media Creative & Content Strategist
description:
Role: Social Media Creative & Content Strategist

Type: Part-Time Contractor — 10 hours per week to start

Rate: From $10 AUD/hr on a contractor basis

Location: Remote — Philippines-based preferred







Who We Are

We are an Australian-owned B2B business that works with Australian companies so we need someone who can help us target B2B companies and grow our business.

We have a strong story to tell — real results and happy clients. Now we need someone who can help us tell it. We're growing and we want our social media presence to reflect the quality of what we deliver.





The Role

This is not a posting-and-scheduling role. We're looking for a creative, strategic and design-led social media specialist who can help take our organic presence across Instagram,
 and 
 to the next level.

You'll be working to grow our page from the ground up — developing content that attracts Australian business owners, builds credibility and makes us the obvious choice when they're ready to hire. The role starts at 10 hours per week and will grow as the page grows. The more impact you have, the more opportunity there is.



This is a creative-first role. We need someone who can design, strategise and bring fresh ideas — not someone who just reposts and schedules. A strong design portfolio is essential.









What You'll Be Doing

Creative & Design

Design high-quality Instagram carousels, graphics, Reel covers and story content that stops the scroll

Create compelling candidate spotlights that showcase the quality of our talent

Turn client testimonials, success stories and results into engaging, shareable social content

Develop creative concepts and assets for organic social — and support Meta advertising creative where needed

Build reusable Canva templates and maintain a consistent visual identity across all platforms

Brand Development

Review our existing presence and identify clear opportunities to improve the look, feel and consistency

Help refine our visual direction — typography, layouts, colour use and overall creative identity

Ensure everything we put out reflects a premium, credible Australian B2B brand

Bring your own creative point of view — we want ideas, not just execution

LinkedIn Management

Manage and grow our LinkedIn presence — posting consistently and building a professional audience

Create LinkedIn-native content that speaks to Australian business owners, founders and hiring managers

Develop thought leadership content, company updates and talent spotlights tailored to the LinkedIn format

Engage with comments, grow our following and position us as a credible B2B brand on the platform

Content Strategy

Develop monthly content plans and content pillars across Instagram,
 and 

Research competitors, industry trends and what's working in B2B social content

Develop ideas for Reels, carousels, educational posts and LinkedIn content that resonate with Australian business owners and decision-makers

Help communicate our value proposition, talent quality and client results in a way that converts

Performance & Optimisation

Track content performance and identify what's landing with our audience

Recommend new creative angles, hooks and formats to test

Continuously improve the quality and impact of our organic content over time





Must Have

A strong portfolio — social media design, carousels, branding or creative campaigns you've personally built

Advanced Canva skills and a genuine eye for design, typography and visual storytelling

Experience creating content for businesses, agencies or B2B brands

An understanding of content strategy, audience positioning and organic social growth

Strong written English — you understand how to speak to Australian business audiences

Someone proactive who brings ideas, takes initiative and can work without hand-holding



Highly Desirable

Adobe Photoshop or Illustrator experience

Experience growing an organic social page from scratch or low follower base

Understanding of Meta advertising and how organic and paid content work together

Experience growing a LinkedIn company page and understanding of what performs on the platform

Experience working with Australian or B2B brands





What Success Looks Like

A more polished, consistent and recognisable brand presence across Instagram,
 and 

Higher-quality graphics, carousels and Reel covers that we're proud to put our name on

Content ideas that genuinely showcase our talent and client results

A clear, strategic approach to our social presence that drives real enquiries from Australian businesses

A role that grows — more hours, more responsibility, more ownership — as the page grows





How to Apply

Answer the questions below and include your portfolio. We want to see your design work and creative thinking — not just a list of accounts you've managed. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a small paid creative task.



Q1.  Walk us through your background in social media content and design — what platforms, what brands, what type of content?

Q2.  Share a piece of creative work you're most proud of. What was the brief, what did you make, and what made it work?

Q3.  If you were building a content strategy for our B2B brand from scratch, what would your first 30 days look like?

→  We're looking for strategic thinking here, not a generic answer.

Q4.  Share your portfolio link — including examples of social media graphics, carousels, branding or creative campaigns you've personally worked on.

Q5.  What tools do you use day-to-day for design and content creation?

title: Hospitality Customer Support – Vacation Rentals (Overnight, AI-Savvy)
description:
HOW TO APPLY: complete our application at 
/s/53du0aog (about 40 minutes). We only review applications submitted through this link; clicking Apply on OnlineJobs alone is not enough. If the link doesn't show, log in to OnlineJobs.ph or message us and we'll send it.



THIS IS NOT A SCRIPTED SUPPORT JOB.

RivetStays runs short-term rental homes for guests across North America (Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Expedia), 24/7. On your shift, you own guest issues from the first message to the fix: messages, calls, cleaners, maintenance and the decisions in between. You'll often work with incomplete information, and your calls have real consequences.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Handle guest messages and calls from start to finish: check-in problems, complaints, requests, reviews

• Coordinate cleaners, maintenance and vendors in real time when something breaks

• D
 refunds, credits and compensation for everyday issues, and record every decision accurately

• Keep reservations, listings and our systems accurate (Beds24, Breezeway, PriceLabs, ClickUp, Missive, RingCentral; we'll train you)

• Back-office work: expense and invoice tracking, discrepancy reporting

• Spot repeat problems and suggest fixes to the process, not just the ticket



HOW DECISIONS WORK

You handle routine guest issues on your own. For safety concerns, serious property damage or anything beyond your authority, you take immediate protective action and bring in the right person with a clear summary and recommendation. Your authority grows as your judgment proves itself.



HOW WE WORK

• We operate 24/7. Our team lead works Philippine daytime hours; on night shifts you are often the one on duty, and you hand off cleanly in the morning.

• We use AI every day. You should already use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar (free versions are fine), and know when its answer is wrong.



YOU'RE A FIT IF

• You can take in messy, complicated information and make a sound decision quickly

• You check the facts, act, and confirm the fix actually worked

• When something goes wrong, you contain it fast, tell the right people, and own what happened, including your own mistakes

• You catch the detail everyone else misses

• You never leave a mess for the next shift: open issues are finished or handed off with a clear note



DON'T APPLY IF

• You need a script for everything

• You escalate every decision instead of making it

• You want to clock in, answer messages and clock out



REQUIREMENTS

• Clear written and spoken English

• 60 hours per week on our 24/7 schedule, including overnight Philippine time, weekends and holidays

• Quiet workspace, reliable computer with webcam and headset, stable internet and a backup connection

• Short-term rental or hospitality experience is a plus, not a requirement



PAY

• Starts at US$4 per hour; raises are based on your performance with us

• Two-week paid training at US$4/hour

• Contract role, 60 hours per week; extra hours are paid



HIRING PROCESS

1. Online application (about 35 minutes): a few quick questions, your resume, and a 30-minute realistic shift exercise. AI tools are allowed; you are responsible for every fact in your answer. You'll need a computer with a webcam.

2. If shortlisted: a short AI video interview and a 10-minute reasoning test (about 30 minutes, no AI)

3. Interview with HR (about 30 minutes), including a live guest-call exercise and a short practical AI task

4. Final conversation with the owner

5. Two-week paid training

title: Sales Strategist
description:
Job Description: Sales Strategist 



Overview 

Root Pages is a growing digital marketing agency looking for a thoughtful, relationship-focused Sales Strategist who knows how to listen, understand a business, and build trust before trying to make a sale. 



We are not looking for an aggressive salesperson or someone focused only on hitting outreach numbers. We want someone who is genuinely curious about people, asks good questions, communicates clearly, and takes the time to understand what a potential client actually needs. 



This is a hands-on sales role with significant ownership. You will help us improve how we generate leads, communicate with prospects, conduct sales conversations, follow up, and build long-term client relationships. 



We are specifically looking for someone who wants to grow with the company long-term. As Root Pages grows, this position is intended to develop into a senior sales leadership role with increased compensation, responsibility, and influence over our sales strategy. 



This is a fully remote position intended for candidates based in the Philippines.



Key Responsibilities 

• Build relationships with prospective clients and take time to understand their businesses, challenges, goals, and priorities 

• Conduct consultative sales conversations focused on finding the right solution rather than simply closing a deal 

• Ask thoughtful questions, listen carefully, and make prospects feel heard and understood 

• Develop and improve outbound strategies across
, LinkedIn, referrals, SMS, and other channels 

• Research prospective clients before outreach so communication feels relevant and personal 

• Identify ideal customer profiles, target industries, and strong-fit opportunities 

• Create and improve outreach messages, follow-up sequences, sales scripts, and processes 

• Manage prospect conversations from initial outreach through qualification and closing 

• Follow up consistently without being overly aggressive or impersonal 

• Clearly communicate our services, recommendations, pricing, and expectations 

• Maintain accurate customer records, notes, follow-ups, and pipeline information

• Identify patterns in prospect feedback and share insights that can improve our services, positioning, and sales process 

• Collaborate directly with company leadership on sales strategy and growth 



What Success Looks Like:

Success in this role is not measured only by the number of messages sent or calls made. 



We are looking for someone who can consistently create strong sales opportunities while leaving prospects with a positive impression of Root Pages, whether or not they ultimately become a client. 



Strong performance includes: 

• Building trust quickly with prospective clients 

• Understanding what a prospect actually needs before recommending a solution 

• Maintaining organized and thoughtful follow-up 

• Generating qualified opportunities and new revenue 

• Improving response, conversion, and close rates over time 

• Developing repeatable sales processes that still feel personal 

• Building relationships that can lead to long-term clients, referrals, and repeat business 



The Person We Are Looking For 



The right person is someone who can read a conversation, adapt their communication style, recognize when to listen rather than sell, and make people feel comfortable discussing their business. 



You should be: 

• Warm, professional, and easy to communicate with 

• Naturally curious about people and businesses 

• A strong listener who asks thoughtful follow-up questions 

• Empathetic and able to understand different personalities and communication styles 

• Comfortable building relationships over time rather than forcing an immediate sale 

• Confident without being pushy 

• Organized and dependable with follow-up 

• Comfortable receiving feedback and continuously improving 

• Able to take ownership without needing constant direction 

• Motivated by helping both the client and the company succeed 



Qualifications 

• Experience in sales, business development, account management, or a similar client-facing role 

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills 

• Demonstrated ability to build rapport and maintain professional relationships 

• Comfortable with outbound prospecting and handling rejection professionally 

• Ability to manage multiple conversations and follow-ups without losing the personal touch 

• Familiarity with CRM systems and sales tools 

• Experience with digital marketing, websites, SEO, advertising, or service-based businesses is a strong advantage 



Compensation 



Base Pay: 

PHP 420–PHP 630 per hour 



Full-time, 40 hours per week. Starting rate will depend on experience, communication skills, and demonstrated capability.



High performers will have the opportunity to significantly increase their total compensation as their pipeline and sales volume grow. 



As the company expands, this role is expected to develop into a senior sales leadership position with additional compensation, authority, and responsibility. 



Work Arrangement 

• Full-time remote position 

• Long-term position 



Why Join Root Pages? 

We Value You & Your Time 



We believe people do their best work when they feel respected, supported, and trusted. We want to build a company where people can grow professionally without sacrificing their personal well-being. 



Work-life balance is encouraged and protected. 



Paid Time Off & Holidays 

• 12 Paid Philippine Holidays 

• 1 Paid Company Holiday 

• 11 Flexible Paid Vacation Days, accrued over time 

• 7 Paid Sick Days, accrued over time 



Flexible Scheduling 

Life requires flexibility. We accommodate reasonable schedule adjustments whenever possible. With advance notice and manager approval, we work together to support personal responsibilities while maintaining strong team performance. 



Weathering Storms Together 

During major storms, natural disasters, and extreme weather events, we provide additional flexibility and support. Your safety and the well-being of your family come first. 



Growth Opportunity 

We are building for the long term and want this person to grow with us. 



A successful Sales Strategist will have the opportunity to take increasing ownership of our sales department, help shape future sales processes, mentor future team members, and advance into a senior sales leadership role as Root Pages grows. 



How to Apply 



Please include: 

• Your resume 

• A short paragraph explaining why you believe you would be a strong fit for this role 

• An example of a time when listening carefully to a customer or client changed how you approached a situation 

• An example of how you built or maintained a strong professional relationship 

• Your expected hourly rate in PHP 



We are especially interested in candidates who can demonstrate how they communicate with people, not just their sales numbers.
